name: sticky-notes
description: Sticky notes Claude pins while it works: MCP tools, a sticky CLI, a skill, and a pane beside the chat

scripts.build:
esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/sticky.js --minify-whitespace --minify-syntax --legal-comments=none --log-level=warning "--banner:js=#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
